battle.name: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗
battle.brief: 蘇聯入侵阿富汗衝突始於一九七九年十二月，蘇聯軍隊進入阿富汗後，與反抗蘇聯介入的游擊力量持續交戰。蘇聯陸軍使用T-62主力坦克，參與突破、機動與火力支援；此型號於一九六一年列裝並投入戰役。

kit.name: T-62主戰坦克
kit.history: T-62是蘇聯陸軍裝甲部隊的主戰坦克，部署於坦克部隊，負責正面突破、機動作戰與近距離火力支援，並配合步兵作戰。

countries: 1979年12月24日直接交戰的兩個國家是蘇聯與阿富汗民主共和國；蘇聯的烏茲別克斯坦、土庫曼斯坦與塔吉克斯坦不是中立第三國，而是北方後勤及出兵體系。捷爾梅茲是第108摩托化步兵師的駐地，也是主要鐵路與機場樞紐。該師先頭部隊由海拉坦渡過阿姆河，沿海拉坦至伊什卡什姆公路轉入阿什卡什姆，再接上巴格蘭與薩朗公路。庫什卡、杜尚別及塔什干方向的公路網，支援第180、第122與第201摩托化步兵師等單位進入西部、北部與東南部。蘇軍在阿富汗的主要空中支點包括捷爾梅茲、喀夫爾尼薩、巴格蘭、喀布爾、賈拉勒阿巴德、坎大哈、希南丹和法拉，但各地兵力和任務一直變動。巴基斯坦不是1979年進攻中的直接交戰者，卻是邊境通行與外部支援通道；美國經巴基斯坦向抗蘇武裝提供武器，中國向喀布爾政府供應軍火。這使喀布爾、法拉、坎大哈、賈拉勒阿巴德、海拉坦及通往巴基斯坦邊境的道路，構成持續九年的主要戰區。
countriesEn: The two direct belligerents on 24 December 1979 were the Soviet Union and the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan. The Soviet Uzbek, Turkmen, and Tajik republics were not neutral third countries; they formed the northern logistics and deployment system. Termez, home of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, was the principal railhead and aviation hub. Its leading echelon crossed the Amu Darya at Hairatan, followed the Hairatan-to-Ishkashim road, turned toward Ishkashim, and connected with the routes to Bagram and the Salang Highway. The road networks centered on Kushka, Dushanbe, and Tashkent supported the movement of formations including the 180th, 122d, and 201st Motor Rifle Divisions into western, northern, and southeastern Afghanistan. Major Soviet air bases and staging points included Termez, Kafarnisa, Bagram, Kabul, Jalalabad, Kandahar, Shindand, and Farah, although deployments and missions changed continually. Pakistan was not a direct belligerent in the initial attack, but it provided a border corridor through which outside assistance entered. The United States supplied weapons to forces opposing the Soviet-backed government through Pakistan, while China supplied arms to the Kabul government. Kabul, Farah, Kandahar, Jalalabad, Hairatan, and the approaches to Pakistan consequently formed the principal operating geography of a war lasting nine years.
people: 政治與最高指揮層面，蘇共中央書記安德羅波夫主張採取直接干預，國防部長德米特里·烏斯季諾夫及蘇聯最高軍事指揮部負責批准兵力、武器與空運安排，克里姆林宮和國安委員會則在莫斯科與中亞之間協調決定。地面首波攻勢由第108摩托化步兵師先頭部隊、蘇軍空降兵及克里姆林宮軍事情報局所屬特遣隊共同執行。阿富汗方面，哈菲佐拉·阿明在1979年4月推翻努爾穆罕默德·塔拉基後掌權；他與宮廷人員在12月24日至27日的喀布爾戰鬥中死亡，蘇聯支持的巴巴拉克·卡爾邁勒於月底接掌政府。喀布爾失守後，阿富汗國防部的指揮關係仍不斷重組，各師對中央命令的服從程度也不一致。另一端的武裝力量分屬不同組織，軍閥古爾布丁·赫克馬亞爾控制伊斯蘭國，賽義夫領導伊斯蘭統一派，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·馬蘇德則長期指揮伊斯蘭大會派。各支武裝依靠自己的情報網、資金與邊境補給活動，前線指揮員經常必須依據當地路況自行決定襲擊、撤退或守點，不能把整個 opposition 視為接受單一命令的軍隊。
peopleEn: At the political and supreme-command level, CPSU leader Yuri Andropov pressed for direct intervention. Defense Minister Dmitry Ustinov and the Soviet high command authorized the deployment of troops, weapons, and airlift, while the Kremlin and security council coordinated decisions between Moscow and Soviet Central Asia. The opening ground effort was shared by leading elements of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, Soviet airborne troops, and a special detachment associated with the KGB Main Military Intelligence Directorate. In Afghanistan, Hafizullah Amin had seized power in April 1979 by overthrowing Nur Muhammad Taraki. He and members of his staff died during the fighting in Kabul from 24 to 27 December, after which the Soviet-backed Babrak Karmal assumed the government at the end of the month. After Kabul fell, command relationships inside the Afghan Defense Ministry continued to be rearranged, and divisions differed markedly in their obedience to central orders. The armed organizations confronting the government were separate. Gulbuddin Hekmatyar led Hizb-e Islami Gulbuddin, Sayyaf headed Ittihad-i Islami, and Ahmad Shah Massoud commanded Jamiat-e Islami. These organizations relied on their own intelligence networks, funding, and border supply arrangements. Front commanders frequently had to decide attacks, withdrawals, and base defense from local conditions, and the opposition could not be treated as an army operating under a single chain of command.
kits: 雙方使用的裝備都真實存在，而且型號在1979年底以前已經列裝；並非每一個型號同時出現在每一支部隊。蘇軍坦克主力包括T-62與T-64A，後續調入的裝甲部隊也可見T-72； infantry 防護依靠BMP-1步兵戰鬥車、BTR-60與BTR-70裝甲運兵車、BTR-80以及BRDM-2輪式裝甲車。阿富汗軍仍保有T-34-85、T-54、T-55和PT-76等坦克，因此正面反坦克火力與機載反坦克武器同樣常見。步兵輕武器包括AK-47、AKM、AK-74、PKM、RPG-7及KPV重機槍，對應的7.62×39毫米、7.62×54毫米、5.45×39毫米和14.5毫米彈藥會隨基層作戰與後勤車隊一起流動。炮兵使用D-30式122毫米榴彈炮、M-46式152毫米榴彈炮及BM-21火箭炮，射擊需要大量炮彈、火箭彈、火藥包、瞄具備件和炮管維修器材。空中武器包括蘇軍MiG-21bis、MiG-23、Mi-8與Mi-24直升機，以及阿軍MiG-21MF、Su-20；An-24、An-2和Il-76負責把輪式車輛、燃料與炮兵裝置送入中轉站。Ural-375D、ZIL-131與KAZ-608等卡車承擔日常運輸。輪胎、底盤、履帶和發動機備件的消耗速度，往往決定一支部隊能連續作戰多久。
kitsEn: All the equipment mentioned was real and had entered service before the end of 1979, although no single formation carried every model at the same time. Soviet armored strength centered on the T-62 and T-64A, with T-72 tanks appearing in armored units brought into the theater later. Infantry protection came from BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-60 and BTR-70 armored personnel carriers, the BTR-80, and BRDM-2 wheeled armored vehicles. Afghan forces retained the T-34-85, T-54, T-55, and PT-76, so direct tank engagements were only one part of the anti-armor problem. Infantry weapons included the AK-47, AKM, AK-74, PKM, RPG-7, and KPV machine gun, with 7.62×39 mm, 7.62×54 mm, 5.45×39 mm, and 14.5 mm ammunition moving with combat units and logistics convoys. Artillery included the D-30 122 mm howitzer, M-46 152 mm howitzer, and BM-21 rocket launcher. Their support requirements extended to artillery ammunition, rockets, propellant charges, sighting equipment, spare parts, and gun-tube maintenance. Air operations involved Soviet MiG-21bis and MiG-23 aircraft, Mi-8 and Mi-24 helicopters, and Afghan MiG-21MF and Su-20 aircraft. An-24, An-2, and Il-76 transports moved trucks, fuel, and artillery equipment into intermediate depots. Ural-375D, ZIL-131, and KAZ-608 trucks carried routine supplies. Tire, chassis, track, and engine consumption often determined how long a unit could remain in continuous combat.
tactics: 12月24日凌晨，蘇軍先以空降兵控制巴格蘭機場和跑道，再由特遣隊進入喀布爾，奪取通訊、指揮及廣播節點；第108師先頭部隊則從捷爾梅茲方向渡河，沿公路向巴格蘭推進。天亮後，坦克和裝甲運兵車隊進入喀布爾，與國王宮、行政區及中央電台周圍的阿軍守軍交火。阿明政府失去城外公路與機場控制後，宮區及市中心仍在相互射擊，但通信中斷使各單位難以維持統一指揮。主要蘇軍縱隊在27日前後退出喀布爾市中心，留下空降兵、警衛部隊和巴格蘭基地，公開干預因此沒有立即變成全國占領。1980年以後，戰爭轉變為基地防衛與道路控制之爭。蘇軍把團與營集中於巴格蘭、喀布爾、薩朗公路沿線、賈拉勒阿巴德、坎大哈及其他交通樞紐，以D-30、M-46、BM-21和Mi-24支援車隊反擊或清除據點。抗蘇武裝則利用山區、岔路、友軍火力支援範圍和夜間行動，在道路狹窄處發動伏擊，破壞道路，切斷遠距離據點，並以小型突擊隊、火箭筒、地雷及路邊炸藥消耗巡邏與補給車隊。這種作戰沒有使任何一方永久控制國土；政府軍仍占據主要城市和幹線，抗蘇武裝則控制廣大鄉間與部分山區。1987年5月的Magistral行動出動政府軍與蘇軍，試圖奪回薩朗公路及若干被封鎖節點，仍顯示遠距離機動必須依靠護衛、炮兵與空軍協同。
tacticsEn: Early on 24 December, Soviet airborne troops seized Bagram airfield and its runway, while special detachments entered Kabul and took communications, command, and broadcasting installations. Leading elements of the 108th Division crossed the river from Termez and advanced toward Bagram by road. After daylight, tanks and armored personnel carriers entered Kabul and fought Afghan guards around the royal palace, government district, and central broadcasting station. With the roads outside Kabul and the airfields no longer secure, fighting continued in the palace area and central city, but disrupted communications made unified command increasingly difficult. The main Soviet columns withdrew from central Kabul around 27 December, leaving airborne troops, guards, and the Bagram base behind; the intervention did not immediately become an occupation of the entire country. From 1980 onward, the war became a contest over base defense and lines of movement. Soviet regiments and battalions concentrated around Bagram, Kabul, the Salang Highway, Jalalabad, Kandahar, and other transport nodes, using D-30 and M-46 artillery, BM-21 rockets, and Mi-24 helicopters against convoys and strongpoints. Opposition forces used mountains, secondary roads, the limited reach of friendly fire support, and night movement to ambush narrow approaches, damage roads, cut distant bases, and wear patrol and supply columns with small assault teams, rocket launchers, mines, and roadside explosive devices. Neither side gained permanent control of the country. Government forces held major cities and trunk routes, while opposition organizations controlled extensive rural and mountain areas. The Magistral operation of May 1987 mobilized Afghan and Soviet troops to recover sections of the Salang Highway and other blocked nodes, again demonstrating that long-distance movement required escorts, artillery, and air-ground coordination.
data: 可核對的時間與編制顯示，1979年首波攻勢主要是第108摩托化步兵師的先頭部隊、空降兵和特遣隊，而不是已經完成部署的整個蘇軍集群。蘇聯於1980年5月成立駐阿富汗第40軍；到1980年代中期，其核心地面編制通常列有第25、第108、第122、第180及第201摩托化步兵師，另有空降兵、航空兵、炮兵、獨立營團與後勤單位。師級單位不是全程同時到位，有的分批進入，有的輪換，有的任務轉向防守其他國家，因此不能把某一年的師數直接當成每天都在戰場上的總兵力。公開資料對蘇軍兵力估算差距很大，但大多落在八萬至十二萬之間；較常見的計算把作戰、支援、空運與後勤人員一併計入。單兵輪換多約十二至十八個月。捷爾梅茲至喀布爾的補給路線超過一千公里，炮彈、柴油、輪式車、履帶備件和食品都依賴鐵路、公路與空運銜接。戰爭從1979年12月24日延續至1989年2月9日：1980年5月建立第40軍，1988年4月14日簽訂日內瓦協議，1988年5月15日開始撤退，1989年2月9日完成最後撤離。蘇軍死亡、失踪、受傷及因傷退役的人數，在不同官方與私人資料中採用不同口徑，不能把其中任何一個估算冒充完整精確總數。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology and order of battle show that the opening attack mainly involved leading elements of the 108th Motor Rifle Division, airborne troops, and special detachments, not a fully deployed Soviet army group. The Soviet Union formed the 40th Army in Afghanistan in May 1980. By the middle of the decade, its core ground order of battle commonly included the 25th, 108th, 122d, 180th, and 201st Motor Rifle Divisions, together with airborne, aviation, artillery, independent brigade, and logistics units. These divisions were not all present simultaneously. Some entered in stages, some rotated, and some shifted to missions outside Afghanistan, so a division total from one year cannot be treated as the number physically present every day. Public estimates of Soviet strength vary, but most fall within a range of 80,000 to 120,000, with calculations differing over whether combat, support, airlift, and rear-service personnel were included. Individual rotations commonly lasted about twelve to eighteen months. The supply route from Termez to Kabul exceeded 1,000 kilometers, and artillery ammunition, diesel, wheeled vehicles, track spares, and food depended on the connection between rail, road, and air transport. The war ran from 24 December 1979 to 9 February 1989: the 40th Army was formed in May 1980, the Geneva agreement was signed on 14 April 1988, withdrawal began on 15 May 1988, and the final departure was completed on 9 February 1989. Published Soviet deaths, missing personnel, wounded, and medical discharges used different definitions. No single estimate should therefore be presented as a complete exact total.
cause: 直接干預的背景至少包括四個相互連接的層次。1978年4月28日的Saur革命終結達烏德汗政府，建立普什基姆派掌權的政府；1979年4月，哈菲佐拉·阿明又推翻塔拉基，使喀布爾與蘇聯原有的安全及經濟關係迅速惡化。美國情報機構與巴基斯坦方面從1979年開始更系統地支持反政府武裝，阿明政府則尋求美國及其他國家援助，這使莫斯科擔心阿富汗進入更明確的反蘇陣營。地理上，蘇聯在阿富汗南部直接面對巴基斯坦；若喀布爾與華盛頓靠近，蘇聯顧慮中亞南部邊防、與巴基斯坦的競爭以及通往印度洋的外交選項受到限制。這些是安全評估，不等同於阿富汗全軍已準備進攻蘇聯。12月中旬，阿明政府所屬部隊與蘇聯邊軍發生武裝衝突，莫斯科又取得一封據稱由阿明提出的求援信，公開以此作為出兵理由；後來證實該信並非阿明發出，邊境衝突則被蘇聯當成立即干預的觸發事件。12月14日蘇共中央作出出兵決定，12月24日部隊便開始進攻。官方藉口、邊境風險判斷與中亞戰略考量因而疊加在同一項決定之中。
causeEn: The immediate intervention rested on several connected developments. The Saur Revolution of 28 April 1978 ended the Daoud government and brought the Pul-e Pakhmak faction to power. In April 1979, Hafizullah Amin overthrew Taraki, rapidly worsening Kabul's previous security and economic relationship with Moscow. Beginning in 1979, American intelligence agencies and Pakistani intermediaries were supporting anti-government armed groups more systematically, while Amin sought assistance from the United States and other countries. Moscow consequently feared a more explicitly anti-Soviet alignment in Kabul. Geographically, the Soviet Union faced Pakistan immediately to the south of Afghanistan. A government in Kabul moving closer to Washington raised Soviet concerns about the security of its southern Central Asian frontier, competition with Pakistan, and access to diplomatic options in the Indian Ocean direction. These were strategic assessments and did not mean that the entire Afghan army was preparing to invade the USSR. In mid-December, Afghan forces and Soviet border troops exchanged fire, and Moscow obtained an alleged request for assistance attributed to Amin. The public justification was based on the border clash and this request, but the letter was later shown not to have come from Amin, while the incident provided the immediate occasion for Soviet action. The CPSU Central Committee approved intervention on 14 December, and forces began attacking on 24 December. The official trigger, border-risk assessment, and Central Asian strategic calculation therefore converged in the same decision.
impact: 戰爭首先改變的是軍隊與地理空間的關係，而不是首都控制本身。抗蘇武裝在1979年以前已經存在，蘇聯介入未能消滅這股力量，反而使喀布爾政府更加依賴蘇聯炮兵、空中支援、固定基地與北方後勤網。政府軍雖守住多數城市，蘇軍卻很難長期清除鄉間及山區；道路、橋梁、燃料庫與營區因游擊、伏擊、地雷和路邊炸藥承受持續損耗，裝甲車即使沒有被擊毀，也可能因輪胎、底盤、履帶和發動機故障而退出戰鬥。蘇軍的因應方式是集中守備、加強車隊護衛、反覆清理道路、調動Mi-24與Mi-8、以及在據點外建立射擊陣地。這些措施縮短了可供游擊活動的道路，卻也要求更多部隊、燃料、維修與輪替人員。巴基斯坦邊境在軍事上成為外部援助與反蘇武裝補給的樞紐；蘇聯則依靠中國供應和自身空運維持喀布爾。對蘇聯軍事研究而言，阿富汗提供了山地作戰、車隊防衛和空地協同的實例，迫使指揮部門思考如何限制裝甲部隊分散及輪替風險。1988年撤軍開始後，政府軍雖仍保有蘇制武器，卻失去原有後勤與航空支援，阿富汗國防體系難以取代蘇聯網絡。這種 military imbalance 最終在1992年與政府崩解及武裝派系奪取喀布爾同時顯現。
impactEn: The first major effect was to change the relationship between armies and geography, not merely the control of the capital. Armed opposition already existed before 1979, and Soviet intervention failed to eliminate it. The Kabul government became more dependent on Soviet artillery, air support, fixed bases, and northern logistics. Government forces held most major cities, but Soviet troops could not permanently clear the countryside and mountains. Roads, bridges, fuel depots, and camps suffered repeated damage from ambushes, mines, and roadside explosive devices. Armored vehicles could leave combat through tire, suspension, track, or engine failures even when they were not destroyed. Soviet responses included concentration on base defense, stronger convoy escort, repeated route clearance, Mi-24 and Mi-8 employment, and prepared fire positions outside fortified areas. These measures restricted ground available to guerrilla operations but required more troops, fuel, maintenance, and rotation. Pakistan's border zone became a military hub for external assistance and opposition supply, while the Soviet Union maintained Kabul through Chinese supplies and its own airlift. Within Soviet military analysis, Afghanistan became a practical case study of mountain operations, convoy defense, and air-ground coordination, forcing commanders to manage the risks created by dispersed armored formations and frequent rotations. After withdrawal began in 1988, Afghan government forces still held Soviet-pattern equipment but lost the established logistics and aviation network, and the defense system could not readily replace the Soviet organization. That military imbalance became visible when the government collapsed and armed factions took Kabul in 1992.
result: 1988年4月14日的日內瓦協議由美國與蘇聯擔任保證人，阿富汗與巴基斯坦接受其安排；協議要求蘇軍分階段撤出，並由美蘇停止對交戰方提供軍火，阿富汗不得容許外國部隊利用其領土進攻蘇聯或巴基斯坦。蘇聯原定按照協議安排分批撤軍，後來決定加速完成。1988年5月15日，第一批車隊開始離開南部據點；南部部隊經坎大哈、斯平博爾達克及土庫曼方向撤出，北部部隊則由喀布爾和巴格蘭經普勒胡姆里、海拉坦返回捷爾梅茲。裝甲車由道路運回，輪式車裝上火車或大批車隊返國，剩餘火炮與彈藥重新盤點，一部分留給阿富汗政府軍，其餘裝備撤回或處理。撤退期間，喀布爾與各地蘇軍基地逐步縮成駐軍點，但抗蘇武裝也沒有在1988年控制首都。1989年2月9日，最後的蘇軍部隊在海拉坦渡過阿姆河，歷時九年的蘇聯直接軍事介入結束。蘇聯是以完成撤軍而非被逐出巴格蘭或喀布爾的方式結束行動；其近十年建立的喀布爾政府則在失去蘇軍保障後維持到1992年，隨後因國防軍分裂及武裝派系進攻而垮台。整個過程顯示，1979年的首波攻勢能迅速改變首都，但長期控制仍取決於能否持續保護道路、城市與後勤節點。
resultEn: The Geneva agreement of 14 April 1988 was guaranteed by the United States and the Soviet Union and accepted by Afghanistan and Pakistan. It required phased Soviet withdrawal, a halt in American and Soviet military support for the belligerents, and an Afghan commitment not to permit foreign troops to use Afghan territory against the USSR or Pakistan. The Soviet Union initially intended to follow the staged timetable but then accelerated the withdrawal. The first convoys departed southern positions on 15 May 1988. Southern formations withdrew through Kandahar, Spin Boldak, and the Turkmen direction, while northern formations moved from Kabul and Bagram through Pul-e-Khumri and Hairatan to Termez. Armored vehicles returned by road, wheeled vehicles traveled by rail or in large organized convoys, and remaining artillery and ammunition were inventoried. Some equipment passed to Afghan government forces, while the rest returned to the Soviet Union or was otherwise processed. Soviet bases around Kabul and other cities contracted to smaller detachments during the withdrawal, but opposition forces did not enter the capital in 1988. On 9 February 1989, the last Soviet troops crossed the Amu Darya at Hairatan, ending nine years of direct Soviet military intervention. The Soviet departure was completed through an international withdrawal rather than a forced retreat from Bagram or Kabul. The Soviet-supported Kabul government survived the loss of Soviet troops until 1992, when divisions of the Afghan armed forces and attacks by armed factions brought the government down. The full sequence shows that the opening attack could change control of the capital quickly, but lasting control depended on the ability to protect roads, cities, and logistics nodes.
